nodes.description: Address of the OpenSea proxy registry used for gas-less approval whitelisting.
Base mint price in wei (initialized to 0.05 ETH); used in payment arithmetic in wlMint and batchMint.
Maximum total token supply (3050) enforced in batchMint.
Allowlist supply cap (2500) enforced in wlMint and team mint paths.
Merkle root used to verify allowlist membership in wlMint; updated by setMerkleRoot.
Boolean flag gating the allowlist mint phase; set by commenceWlMint.
Boolean flag gating the public mint phase; set by commencePublicMint.
Mapping of addresses allowed to mint team tokens; written in addTeamMinters and consumed/cleared in wlMint and batchMint.
Public mapping of day-of minters declared but never written in this implementation.
CountersUpgradeable.Counter tracking the next token id; incremented during every mint.
Owner address from OwnableUpgradeable; read by owner() in withdrawAll and used by onlyOwner gates.
Pausable flag read by whenNotPaused in _beforeTokenTransfer and written by pause/unpause.
Initializer that sets up inherited modules, mints 80 team tokens via _safeMint and sets price/supply config.
Payable allowlist mint; enforces phase flag, merkle proof, payment and supply limits, then mints with _safeMint.
Payable public mint; enforces phase flag, max 5 per tx, payment and total supply, then mints with _safeMint.
Owner-only function that flags addresses in the teamMinters mapping.
Owner-only setter for the allowlist merkle root.
Owner-only function enabling the allowlist mint phase.
Owner-only function enabling the public mint phase.
Overridden approval check that additionally whitelists the OpenSea proxy for each owner.
View returning the current value of the token id counter.
Internal view returning the hardcoded metadata base URI.
Owner-only function that pauses token transfers.
Owner-only function that unpauses token transfers.
Transfer hook overridden with whenNotPaused and super call for enumeration bookkeeping.
UUPS upgrade authorization hook restricted to the owner.
Internal burn override combining ERC721 and ERC721URIStorage burn logic.
View returning the token URI by delegating to ERC721URIStorage.
ERC165 interface support check combining ERC721 and Enumerable implementations.
Public function that sends the full contract balance to owner(); has no access control modifier.
ERC721 internal safe mint that mints and then invokes the receiver hook on contract recipients.
ERC721 internal mint updating balances, owners and emitting Transfer.
Private helper performing the try/catch external call to the ERC721 receiver.
External receiver callback entry point invoked on mint/transfer to contracts; reentrancy surface.
msg.sender / _msgSender(): attacker-controlled caller used for teamMinters lookups, mint recipients and transfer authorization.
Low-level payable(owner()).send(amount) in withdrawAll whose boolean return is only checked via require; unguarded by access control.
External call to IERC721ReceiverUpgradeable.onERC721Received on an attacker-supplied recipient before state is finalized.
count parameter of wlMint bounding tokens minted per transaction.
Merkle proof array parameter of wlMint.
count parameter of batchMint bounding tokens minted per transaction.
Array of addresses to flag as team minters.
New merkle root value assigned to state in setMerkleRoot.
Address of the new implementation passed to the upgrade authorization hook.
Token id to burn in _burn.
Token id queried for its URI in tokenURI.
Interface identifier queried in supportsInterface.
Local variable holding address(this).balance before the payable send in withdrawAll.
Owner address queried in isApprovedForAll for proxy whitelisting.
Operator address checked against the OpenSea proxy in isApprovedForAll.
Source address of the transfer hook.
Destination address of the transfer hook.
Token id being transferred in the hook.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read from teamMinters[msg.sender] to decide the mint path and is the mint recipient in wlMint.
msg.sender is read from teamMinters[msg.sender] to decide the mint path and is the mint recipient in batchMint.
_msgSender() is forwarded as the operator argument into the receiver callback onERC721Received.
teamMinters mapping read and cleared determines privileged minting in wlMint.
teamMinters mapping read and cleared determines privileged minting in batchMint.
merkleRoot is consumed by MerkleProofUpgradeable.verify to gate allowlist minting in wlMint.
basePrice is used in msg.value / basePrice and basePrice * count without overflow checks in the team-mint branch.
_wlSupply is the upper bound checked before each mint in wlMint.
_wlMint flag must be true for wlMint to proceed.
_tokenIdCounter.current()/increment() drive token id allocation in wlMint.
_publicMint flag must be true for batchMint to proceed.
_totalSupply is the upper bound checked before each mint in batchMint.
_tokenIdCounter.current()/increment() drive token id allocation in batchMint.
basePrice is used in msg.value / basePrice and basePrice * count in batchMint.
wlMint mints through _safeMint, which hands control to the recipient contract before/around state finalization.
batchMint mints through _safeMint, which hands control to the recipient contract during execution.
initialize mints 80 tokens via _safeMint in a loop, invoking the receiver hook.
_safeMint delegates the state-changing mint to _mint.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received after minting to notify the recipient.
_checkOnERC721Received performs the try/catch external call into onERC721Received on the recipient.
_checkOnERC721Received triggers the unsafe external onERC721Received call node with attacker-controlled recipient.
withdrawAll reads the balance and performs the low-level send represented by the unsafe operation node.
withdrawAll resolves the destination through owner() with no onlyOwner modifier, so any caller can trigger the transfer to the owner.
withdrawAll reads the _owner state variable via owner() to compute the send recipient.
addTeamMinters writes true into the teamMinters mapping for each supplied address.
setMerkleRoot writes the merkleRoot state variable controlling allowlist verification.
commenceWlMint sets _wlMint to true, enabling the allowlist mint phase.
commencePublicMint sets _publicMint to true, enabling the public mint phase.
isApprovedForAll reads proxyRegistryAddress to query the OpenSea proxy mapping.
_beforeTokenTransfer is guarded by whenNotPaused which reads _paused.
pause sets _paused to true through _pause.
unpause sets _paused to false through _unpause.
_authorizeUpgrade is restricted by onlyOwner which reads _owner.
count parameter bounds the number of iterations and the required payment in wlMint.
proof parameter is passed into MerkleProofUpgradeable.verify inside wlMint.
count parameter bounds the number of iterations and the required payment in batchMint.
users array is iterated to flag each address in teamMinters.
_merkleRoot parameter is assigned to the merkleRoot state variable.
newImplementation parameter is the upgrade target authorized in _authorizeUpgrade.
the amount local variable is passed directly into the low-level send in withdrawAll.
tokenId parameter selects the token destroyed in _burn.
tokenId parameter selects the token whose URI is returned in tokenURI.
interfaceId parameter is compared against supported interface ids in supportsInterface.
owner parameter indexes the OpenSea proxy registry mapping in isApprovedForAll.
operator parameter is compared against the resolved proxy address in isApprovedForAll.
from parameter is forwarded to the super transfer hook in _beforeTokenTransfer.
to parameter is forwarded to the super transfer hook in _beforeTokenTransfer.
tokenId parameter is forwarded to the super transfer hook in _beforeTokenTransfer.

normalization_plan.reason: The count parameter only exists as a bound for the mint loop and payment check inside wlMint.
The proof parameter is used only as input to the merkle verification performed by wlMint.
The count parameter is used only to bound iterations and required payment inside batchMint.
The users array is iterated only to write the teamMinters mapping inside addTeamMinters.
The _merkleRoot parameter is immediately assigned to the merkleRoot state variable inside setMerkleRoot.
The newImplementation parameter is the sole argument of the owner-only upgrade authorization hook.
The tokenId parameter selects the token destroyed by _burn and has no meaning outside it.
The tokenId parameter only selects which URI the tokenURI view returns.
The interfaceId parameter is only compared against known interface ids in supportsInterface.
The amount local is the contract balance passed straight into the low-level send unsafe operation.
The owner parameter is used only to query the OpenSea proxy registry inside isApprovedForAll.
The operator parameter is used only for the proxy equality comparison inside isApprovedForAll.
The from parameter is only forwarded to the inherited transfer hook.
The to parameter is only forwarded to the inherited transfer hook.
The tokenId parameter is only forwarded to the inherited transfer hook.
